about_the_game:
The most accurate and detailed GE ES44AC in the Trainz Simulator market. From a highly detailed and accurate cabin made correct down the the proper seats and paper work found in the real operating cab. This is Operator Series Product has many programmed features and audio recorded off of the real equipment. CP Rail series 8760-8839 was the second order of ES44AC that CP ordered. These featured HiAd Trucks and a conventional GEVO Cab.

Some of The Features…

  • Realistic Specular/normal map texture effects

  • Air Hoses and MU Cables

  • Functioning dynamic brakes

  • Auto Running Numbers

  • Road specific highly detailed cab view

  • Scripted cab functions

  • Realistic in-cab sounds

  • Openable engine compartment doors,

  • Openable Front and Rear cab doors,

  • High qualify GEVO-12 engine sound
